question: After the stale-base source defect is fixed, should configured approval delivery failures resolve immediately as no-route instead of falling back to the originating turn source?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but accepting stricter configured-route failure semantics and awaiting delivery outcomes can change existing operator workflows and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Strict Configured-Route Semantics
options.body: After the undefined identifier is fixed, land the behavior so failed or fully suppressed configured delivery resolves no-route immediately.

options.title: Require Compatibility Mode
options.body: Keep existing fallback-after-failure behavior by default and add an explicit strict path only if maintainers want an upgrade-preserving rollout.

options.title: Pause The PR
options.body: Leave the linked issue open while gateway owners decide the approval delivery contract before more implementation work lands.

recommendation.title: Accept Strict Configured-Route Semantics
recommendation.body: After the undefined identifier is fixed, land the behavior so failed or fully suppressed configured delivery resolves no-route immediately.
